result.summary: Found 1 issue: overlapping text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, where the delivery time and delivery fee texts are rendered on top of each other.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time ('25–30 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') texts overlap and render on top of each other, making both unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout so the delivery time and delivery fee are laid out side by side with proper spacing, or combine them into a single text element.
